patientRequestRecorded.en: Your request has been recorded for processing.
patientRequestRecorded.translation: Min binndii ɗaɓɓitannde maa ngam gollal.

patientAwaitingReview.en: Your information has been saved for review by the care team.
patientAwaitingReview.translation: Humpito maa mooftaama ngam dental toppitagol ƴeewta.

patientNoCallSummary.en: No clinical summary has been recorded for this call.
patientNoCallSummary.translation: Alaa tonngol humpito cellal winndangol e noddaango ngo.

welcomeTitle.en: Let's get you ready for your visit.

welcomeSubtitle.en: Answer a few questions about your symptoms. Your doctor reviews everything before you meet.
welcomeSubtitle.translation: Jaabo naamne seeɗa baɗte maande nyawu maa. Doktoor maa ƴeewtoto kala huunde hade on pottude.

identitySubtitle.en: This connects your visit to your record.
identitySubtitle.translation: Ɗum jokkondirata yillere maa e deftere maa.

placeholderComplaint.translation: Haal maande nyawu ɓurnde tampinde maa…

interviewAsking.translation: Min naamnata baɗte maande nyawu maa

interviewComplete.en: Thanks, {name}. I have what I need. Let's review your answers before sending them to the doctor.
interviewComplete.translation: Min njaraama, {name}. Mi heɓii ko mi sokli. En ƴeewto jaabawuuji maa hade neldugo ɗi to doktoor.

interviewOpener.en: Thanks — I'll ask a few quick questions about your {complaint}. When did it start?
interviewOpener.translation: Min njaraama — mi naamnoto seeɗa baɗte {complaint} maa. Ndeen ɗum fuɗɗi?

interviewOpenerFallback.en: Thanks — I'll ask a few quick questions about what brought you in. When did it start?
interviewOpenerFallback.translation: Min njaraama — mi naamnoto seeɗa baɗte ko waddiri maa. Ndeen ɗum fuɗɗi?

composerHintChips.en: Type a reply, or tap a suggestion above
composerHintChips.translation: Winndu jaabawol, walla doɓ suɓannde dow

reviewSubtitle.en: Tap any item to fix it before sending.
reviewSubtitle.translation: Doɓ huunde ngam feewnitugo nde hade neldugo.

emergencyNotice.en: If your symptoms feel severe or are getting worse right now, don't wait — call emergency services.
emergencyNotice.translation: So maande nyawu maa tiiɗii walla ɓeydoto jooni, hoto sabbo — noddu ballal yaawngal.

urgencyBody.en: Your symptoms suggest something that should be seen soon. We've flagged your case as urgent for the clinical team.
urgencyBody.translation: Maande maa kollata aɗa sokli ƴeewteede yaaw. Min kaalanii dental toppitagol wonde caɗeele maa ina sokli yaawde.

urgencyStep1Desc.en: The clinical team receives your structured history immediately.
urgencyStep1Desc.translation: Dental toppitagol heɓata aslol cellal maa jooni.

urgencyStep2Desc.en: Based on {level} urgency. You will be notified when a clinician opens it.
urgencyStep2Desc.translation: Rewde e daraja yaawde {level}. A humpite so gollowo cellal udditii ɗum.

urgencyStep3Desc.en: Severe or sudden worsening — call emergency services right away.
urgencyStep3Desc.translation: So ɗum tiiɗii walla ɓeydii e ko aɗa ɗaminaani — noddu ballal yaawngal jooni.

notADiagnosis.en: This is an automated urgency estimate, not a diagnosis. A clinician makes the final decision.
notADiagnosis.translation: Ɗum woni hiisa yaawde baɗaaɗo e masin, wonaa anndugol nyawu. Gollowo cellal waɗata suɓannde sakkitiinde.

findHeroSubtitle.en: You've been seen at this hospital before. Send your brief straight there?
findHeroSubtitle.translation: A meeɗii ƴeewteede e lopital ngal. En neldu tonngol humpito maa ɗoon?

findHeroRecordsNote.en: They already hold your records, so your care team sees your full history right away.
findHeroRecordsNote.translation: Ɓe njogii defte maa, ngam ɗum dental toppitagol yiyata aslol maa timmungol jooni.

findSearchTitle.en: Where would you like to be seen?

findSearchSubtitle.en: Pick a Triavi hospital near you — your {level} brief is sent the moment you choose.
findSearchSubtitle.translation: Suɓo lopital Triavi ɓadngal maa — tonngol daraja {level} maa neldetee nde a suɓii.

findScanning.translation: Min ɗaɓɓata lopitalji Triavi ɓadiiɗi maa…

findLevelOnly.translation: Daraja {min} e ko ɓuri ɗum tan

findErrLocation.en: We couldn't get your location. Tap rescan to try again.
findErrLocation.translation: Min mbaawaani yiygo to ngonɗaa. Doɓ ɗaɓɓugo kadi ngam etaade.

statusBody.en: Your brief is with the care team. We'll notify you the moment a clinician opens it.
statusBody.translation: Tonngol humpito maa woni e dental toppitagol. Min humpitay maa nde gollowo cellal udditii ɗum.

timelineOpened.translation: Gollowo cellal udditii tonngol humpito maa

escalateTitle.en: If it's getting worse, act now

escalateBody.en: Don't wait for your queue position. If your symptoms are severe or worsening suddenly — call emergency services now or go to the nearest emergency department.
escalateBody.translation: Hoto sabbo daraja maa e doggol. So maande nyawu maa tiiɗii walla ɓeydii e ko aɗa ɗaminaani — noddu ballal yaawngal jooni walla yah to suudu ballal yaawngal ɓurndu ɓada.

escalateFlagged.en: We've flagged your case as higher priority so the care team is aware.
escalateFlagged.translation: Min ɓeydii ardungol caɗeele maa ngam dental toppitagol annda.

notifyBody.en: A clinician is reviewing your brief. We'll update you as it progresses.
notifyBody.translation: Gollowo cellal ƴeewtata tonngol humpito maa. Min humpitay maa no ɗum yahata.

checkinWelcomeSubtitle.en: Answer a few questions about how you've been since your visit.
checkinWelcomeSubtitle.translation: Jaabo naamne seeɗa baɗte no ɓanndu maa wayi gila yillere maa.

checkinTrendAriaLabel.en: How is your condition compared to before?
checkinTrendAriaLabel.translation: No ɓanndu maa wayi so yerondiraama e adan?

checkinAnythingElse.en: Anything else you'd like to tell us?
checkinAnythingElse.translation: Aɗa jogii ko goɗɗum ngam haalango min?

checkinResultResolved.translation: Min mbeltii sabu ɓanndu maa ɓuri moƴƴude

checkinResultResolvedBody.en: We'll check in again {next} to make sure you're still improving.
checkinResultResolvedBody.translation: Min ƴeewtay maa kadi {next} ngam anndugo aɗa ɓeyda moƴƴude.

checkinResultReview.en: A clinician will look at this today

checkinResultReviewBody.en: Your answers have been sent to the care team. A clinician will review them and reach out if needed.
checkinResultReviewBody.translation: Jaabawuuji maa neldama to dental toppitagol. Gollowo cellal ƴeewtay ɗi, o nodday maa so ina sokli.

checkinResultEscalateBody.en: Your symptoms suggest something that needs prompt attention. Don't wait — contact your care team or go to the nearest emergency department.
checkinResultEscalateBody.translation: Maande maa kollata aɗa sokli ballal yaawngal. Hoto sabbo — noddu dental toppitagol maa walla yah to suudu ballal yaawngal ɓurndu ɓada.

checkinExpiredBody.en: This follow-up is no longer available. Sign in to see your current check-ins.
checkinExpiredBody.translation: Ɗum toppitagol alaa kadi. Naat ngam yiygo winnditagol maa jooni.

claimBody.en: Your check-in is verified. Create a free account to track this visit and skip the code next time.
claimBody.translation: Winnditagol maa teeŋtinaama. Sos konte meere ngam rewinda yillere nde, a woppata kod waktu goɗɗo.

authVerifyBody.en: We'll send a one-time code — no password to remember.
authVerifyBody.translation: Min neldat kod kuutorteeɗo laawol gootol — alaa finnde ngam siiftugo.

authSecuredBy.translation: Triavi hisnata ɗum · Ɗum rewata HIPAA

otpSentTo.en: Sent to {dest}. It expires in 10 minutes.
otpSentTo.translation: Neldama to {dest}. Waktu mum gasata e hojomaaji 10.

signinBody.en: Enter your phone or email and we'll send a sign-in code.
signinBody.translation: Naatnu telefon maa walla iimeel, min neldat kod naatgol.

signinAccountTied.en: Your account is tied to your hospital's records
signinAccountTied.translation: Konte maa jokkondiraa e defte lopital maa

errInvalidPhone.en: Enter a valid phone number (7–14 digits)

errSendFailed.en: Couldn't send the code. Try again.
errSendFailed.translation: Min mbaawaani neldugo kod. Eto kadi.

errNetwork.en: Network error. Check your connection and try again.
errNetwork.translation: Caɗeele jokkondiral. Ƴeewto jokkondiral maa, eto kadi.

errResendFailed.translation: Min mbaawaani neldugo kadi. Eto kadi.

errCodeMismatch.en: That code didn't match. Try again.

sessionExpiredBody.en: For your security and to protect patient data, you've been signed out after a period of inactivity.
sessionExpiredBody.translation: Ngam kisal maa e humpito nyawɓe, a yaltinaama caggal waktu ngo a huutoraani ɗum.

dashNoActiveHint.en: Start a check-in to begin a new visit.

dashCareLinePrivacy.en: Care calls ring in this app · your phone number is never shared.
dashCareLinePrivacy.translation: Noddaali toppitagol ngarat e porogaram ngo · lamba telefon maa sendetaake.

voiceSubtitle.en: Choose who calls you, and how they sound.
voiceSubtitle.translation: Suɓo noddoowo maa e no daande mum wayata.

toneProfessionalDesc.translation: Haala poomaa, feewnde, alaa haala goɗɗa

voiceSampleQuote.en: Hi Jordan, it's time for your evening dose…
voiceSampleQuote.translation: Jam Jordan, waktu leɗɗe maa kiikiɗe hewtii…

medReminderCallsDesc.translation: Noddu e kala waktu leɗɗe suɓaaɗo

quietHoursDesc.en: No calls 9:30 PM – 7:30 AM · falls back to a notification
quietHoursDesc.translation: Alaa noddaali 9:30 jemma – 7:30 subaka · humpitinol neldetee

signedOutBody.en: Your care line stays active — sign back in to manage calls and reminders.
signedOutBody.translation: Lawwol toppitagol maa ina golla — naat kadi ngam toppita noddaali e siftine.

callRingWebRtcFootnote.en: Encrypted voice call · WebRTC · your number is never shared
callRingWebRtcFootnote.translation: Noddaango daande cuuɗaango · WebRTC · lamba maa sendetaake

visitsPrivacyNote.en: Only you and {hospital} can see these. Tap a visit to read the summary shared with you.
visitsPrivacyNote.translation: Aan e {hospital} tan mbaawi yiygo ɗum. Doɓ yillere ngam janngugo tonngol humpito sendangol maa.

visitDetailNoCalls.en: No care calls for this visit yet.
visitDetailNoCalls.translation: Alaa noddaali toppitagol yillere nde tawo.

visitDetailNotDiagnosis.en: This is a summary shared with you — not a diagnosis. If your symptoms return or get worse, seek emergency care right away.
visitDetailNotDiagnosis.translation: Ɗum woni tonngol humpito sendangol maa — wonaa anndugol nyawu. So maande nyawu maa ngartii walla ɓeydii, ɗaɓɓu ballal yaawngal jooni.

visitDetailNotFoundBody.en: This visit may have been removed, or the link is no longer valid. Go back to see your full history.
visitDetailNotFoundBody.translation: Yillere nde waawi momteede, walla jokkol ngol feewaani kadi. Rutto ngam yiygo aslol maa timmungol.

editProfileSubtitle.en: Update your details. Your doctor sees the latest.
editProfileSubtitle.translation: Hesɗitin humpito maa. Doktoor maa yiyata ko hesɗi.

profilePreferredLanguageDesc.en: Changes the language of every screen instantly.
profilePreferredLanguageDesc.translation: Ɗum waylata ɗemngal kelle fuu jooni.

profileCareLineCopyFailed.en: Couldn't copy - select and copy manually
profileCareLineCopyFailed.translation: Nattugol waawaani — suɓo, natto e junngo

privacySubtitle.en: What we protect, and what you control.
privacySubtitle.translation: Ko min kisnata e ko a toppitata.

privacyDeidBody.en: Your name, contact details, and free-text answers are stripped before anything leaves your hospital. Only your care team sees identifying details; research and analytics see de-identified data only.
privacyDeidBody.translation: Innde maa, humpito noddirgol e jaabawuuji binnduɗi momtete hade huunde yaltugo lopital maa. Dental toppitagol maa tan yiyata humpito anndinirgo maa; ɗaɓɓitannde e ƴeewtagol yiyata humpito momtaaɗo anndinirgo tan.

privacyResearchConsentDesc.en: Allow de-identified data to improve care for everyone. You can change this anytime.
privacyResearchConsentDesc.translation: Jaɓ huutoraade humpito mo alaa anndinirgo maa ngam moƴƴintinugo toppitagol yimɓe fuu. A waawi waylugo ɗum sahaa kala.

privacyCommsConsentDesc.en: Appointment reminders and follow-up check-ins by call or push. You can change this anytime.
privacyCommsConsentDesc.translation: Siftine kawral e toppitagol rewindingol e noddaango walla humpitinol. A waawi waylugo ɗum sahaa kala.

privacyDeleteDesc.en: Permanently remove your account and contact details. Your care-line history is retained by your hospital as required by law.
privacyDeleteDesc.translation: Momtu konte maa e humpito noddirgol maa haa abada. Lopital maa mooftata aslol lawwol toppitagol maa no laawol yamiri.

privacyDownloadDesc.en: Request a copy of your visit summaries, medications, and care-call history.
privacyDownloadDesc.translation: Ɗaɓɓu nattannde tonngol yille, leɗɗe e aslol noddaali toppitagol maa.

deleteSheetBody.en: This permanently removes your account and contact details. Your hospital retains your care-line history as required by law. This cannot be undone.
deleteSheetBody.translation: Ɗum momtata konte maa e humpito noddirgol haa abada. Lopital maa mooftata aslol lawwol toppitagol maa no laawol yamiri. Ɗum waawataa artineede.

deleteRequestNextStep.en: Your care team will confirm by email within 72 hours. Your care line stays active until then.
deleteRequestNextStep.translation: Dental toppitagol maa teeŋtinat e iimeel e waktuuji 72. Lawwol toppitagol maa gollata haa ndeen.

downloadSheetBody.en: Choose a format and request your export. We'll prepare it and send a secure link to your registered email.
downloadSheetBody.translation: Suɓo mbaydi, ɗaɓɓu defte maa. Min keblay ɗe, min neldat jokkol kisnol to iimeel maa winndaaɗo.

downloadRequestNextStep.en: We'll email a secure link to your registered address within 24 hours.
downloadRequestNextStep.translation: Min neldat jokkol kisnol to iimeel maa winndaaɗo e waktuuji 24.

downloadFileStubNote.en: No file is downloaded here - your records are sent securely to your registered email.
downloadFileStubNote.translation: Alaa fiilde aawteteende ɗoo — defte maa neldete e kisal to iimeel maa winndaaɗo.

callSummaryDeclinedLogged.en: Call declined ? logged as no contact

callSummaryEndedLogged.en: Call ended ? logged as no contact

inviteBody.en: Paste the invite link your hospital sent, or scan their QR code.
inviteBody.translation: Ɗakku jokkol noddirgol lopital maa neldi, walla ƴeewto kod QR maɓɓe e kamera.

inviteError.en: That doesn't look like a Triavi invite link or code.
inviteError.translation: Ɗum wa'i no wonaa jokkol walla kod noddirgol Triavi.

inviteScanSubtitle.en: Point your camera at the code

inviteInfoStreaming.en: A valid clinic code takes you straight to your details.
inviteInfoStreaming.translation: Kod lopital feewɗo nawata maa to humpito maa poomaa.

inviteInfoDev.en: A valid clinic code takes you straight to your details. Dev: tap Simulate detected code to test the flow.
inviteInfoDev.translation: Kod lopital feewɗo nawata maa to humpito maa. Eto: doɓ misal kod yiytaaɗo ngam etaade lawwol.

inviteInfoDenied.en: Grant camera permission in your browser settings, or enter the invite link manually.
inviteInfoDenied.translation: Yamir kamera e teelte wanngorde maa, walla naatnu jokkol noddirgol e junngo.

inviteInfoNoDevice.en: No camera detected. Enter the invite link your hospital sent instead.
inviteInfoNoDevice.translation: Kamera yiytaaka. Naatnu jokkol noddirgol lopital maa neldi.

inviteInfoUnavailable.en: Camera isn't available right now. Enter the invite link manually.
inviteInfoUnavailable.translation: Kamera alaa jooni. Naatnu jokkol noddirgol e junngo.

interviewOfflineTitle.en: Offline ? showing the saved interview script

questionContext.en: Were you resting or active when it began?
questionContext.translation: Aɗa foofa walla aɗa golla nde ɗum fuɗɗi?

questionSeverity.en: How strong is the discomfort right now?

questionRadiation.translation: Muusere nde ina yaaja to nokku goɗɗo?

questionAssociated.en: Are you noticing any of these as well?
questionAssociated.translation: Aɗa yiya goɗɗum e ɗee kadi?

followupPain.en: How is your pain compared to when you were discharged?
followupPain.translation: No muusere maa wayi so yerondiraama e nde a yalti lopital?

followupMeds.en: Have you been taking your medications as prescribed?
followupMeds.translation: Aɗa yara leɗɗe maa no doktoor yamiri?

followupFever.en: Do you still have a fever?

followupEating.en: Are you able to eat and drink normally?
followupEating.translation: Aɗa waawi nyaamugo e yarugo no woowruɗaa?

choiceLessFood.translation: Mi nyaamata ko famɗi e adan

questionLocation.en: Where do you feel the symptoms?
questionLocation.translation: Toye e ɓanndu maa aɗa nana maande ɗe?

questionModifiers.en: What makes the symptoms better or worse?
questionModifiers.translation: Ko honɗun moƴƴintinata walla bonnata maande ɗe?

questionReady.en: Your answers are ready for review.

errRequest.en: We could not complete your request. Please try again.
errRequest.translation: Min mbaawaani timmingo ɗaɓɓitannde maa. Tiiɗno eto kadi.

demoOnset.translation: Ko e waktuuji 1–3 ɓenniiɗi, e foofugol

questionDuration.en: How long have you had this?
questionDuration.translation: Ko honno juuti aɗa jogii ɗum?

questionCharacter.en: How would you describe the quality of the discomfort?
questionCharacter.translation: No a sifa mbaydi muusere nde?

questionMedications.en: What medications are you currently taking?

questionAllergies.translation: Aɗa jogii ko ɓanndu maa jaɓataa, hono leɗɗe walla ñaamdu?

questionHistory.en: Any relevant medical history I should know about?
questionHistory.translation: Aɗa jogii aslol cellal mo mi sokli anndugo?

questionRedFlags.en: Are you experiencing any severe or alarming symptoms?
questionRedFlags.translation: Aɗa jogii maande nyawu tiiɗɗe walla kulɓinɗe?

questionSeverityScale.en: How strong is the discomfort right now, from 0 to 10?
questionSeverityScale.translation: No semmbe muusere nde jooni, gila 0 haa 10?

callBackHour.en: We'll call you back in 1 hour · {hospital}
callBackHour.translation: Min nodday maa kadi e waktu 1 · {hospital}

demoCallGreeting.translation: Jam {name}, ko {agent} noddata maa iwde e {hospital}.

demoCallEvening.en: I'm calling to remind you about your evening dose of {med}.
demoCallEvening.translation: Mi noddata ngam siftinugo maa leɗɗe maa kiikiɗe, {med}.

demoCallDue.en: It's 8 o'clock — time for your {med}. Have you taken it yet?
demoCallDue.translation: Waktu 8 hewtii — waktu {med} maa. A yarii ɗum?
